rootCauseNote: Until 1a91803 no production lane-B call received its instructions: the runner created control/system-prompt.md with open(..., 'wx', 0o444), the executors run with umask 0077, so the file was 0400 owned by uid 1000; the container runs as uid 65534 and could not read it, and upstream omp v18.9.2 (bd4dffd5 packages/coding-agent/src/system-prompt.ts:291-306) logs a warning and uses the path itself as the system prompt. Consequently all 64 production assessment_b held_quality settlements observed up to 2026-10-16T10:13:03Z (and any later ones before 1a91803) are infrastructure-caused, not genuine quality outcomes. Their receipts and proofs remain immutable history; the changed B contract re-runs lane B for every selected source under the new pin.
confirmation: Lead-authorized private diagnostic calls with 1a91803 under umask 0077 through the production managed Docker path (no production lease or database effects): control at handoff 0444, no prompt-resolution warning; one call returned valid JSON rejected by the strict schema (issues not retained), two calls (same item 5784438b0a2f and item 5b5606a86762) passed the unchanged strict schema.
secondRootCauseNote: On 1a91803 the first three production B answers (jobs 71dfff9b1dbf, 8f459ae61e14, e6eb958e879f) were schema-valid but the native accepted path set the lease to submitted without purge_ack_sha256; assessment_bridge_leases_check4 (SQLSTATE 23514, PostgreSQL server log) rolled back each final transaction and the jobs were held as execution_exception. Fixed in 05d82c3 without changing the constraint.
confirmation05d82c3: Three lead-authorized private diagnostic calls with 05d82c3 on those three items (umask 0077, production managed Docker path, no production effects): control 0444, strict decoder accepted all three; output outcome unresolved for all three with model-declared evidence holds, two still with abstention_usefulness. These are honest quality holds, not admissions.
